verses.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.sm: Samaria Ua oo mai foi le afioga a le ALI ia te au, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.sm: Le atalii e o le tagata, o fafine e toalua, o tama a le fafine e toatasi,

verses.en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
verses.sm: na la talitane i Aikupito; na la talitane a o teine muli i laua; na omia ai o laua susu; na tatao ai susu o laua o taupou.

verses.en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
verses.sm: O la igoa foi, o Aola le matua, ma Aolipa lona uso; na fai foi i laua maʻu, na la fananau foi tama tane ma tamateine. A o laua igoa, o Aola o Samaria lea, o Aolipa o lerusalema lea.

verses.en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
verses.sm: Na mulilua Aola ina o fai maʻu; na ia tu'inanau atu foi i e na mananao ia te ia, o Asuria o e vava lalata ma ia.

verses.en: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.sm: Ua oofu i latou i ofu uli, o ta‘ita‘i, ma faipule, o taulelea aulelei i latou uma, o “au o tietie i solofanua.

verses.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.sm: Maa talitane ia i latou, o i latou uma o aupito sili i tagata o Asuria, ma i latou uma na ia tuʻinanau i ai; na faaleagaina o ia e ia i a latou tupua uma.

verses.en: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
verses.sm: Na ia le tuua lona talitane mai Aikupito; aua na latou momoe ma ia ina o teine muli, na latou tatao foi ona susu o taupou o ia, ma sasaa a latou faitaaga i luga ia te ia.

verses.en: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na ou tuuina atu ai o ia i lima o e na mananao ia te ia, o lima lava o tagata o Asuria, na ia tu‘inanau i ai.

verses.en: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
verses.sm: O i latou na latou faatelenoa ia te ia; na latou ave foi ana tama tane ma ana tama teine; na latou fasioti foi ia te ia i le pelu, ona logologoa lea o ia i fafine ina ua latou faasalaina o ia.

verses.en: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e lona uso o Aolipa, ona faasili lea e ia o lona tu‘inanau i le tu‘inanau o lona uso, ma lona talitane na sili i le talitane o lona uso.

verses.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.sm: Na ia tu‘inanau i tagata o Asuria, o e vava lalata ma ia, o ta‘ita‘i ma faipule o loo oofu faamatagofie’ lava, o “au o tietie i solofenua, o taulelea “aulelei i latou uma.

verses.en: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
verses.sm: Ona ou iloa lea ua leaga o ia, ua tasi lava lo laua ala.

verses.en: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
verses.sm: Ua faateleina e ia lona talitane; aua na ia iloa tane na tusia i le pa, o faatagata foi o Kaletaia, ua tusia i le vali mumu,

verses.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
verses.sm: ua fusia o latou sulugatiti i fusi, ua i o latou ulu o pulou lanu eseese, e tino mai i alii ta‘ita‘i ‘au i latou uma, e pei o tagata Papelonia o Kaletaia ia, o le nuu na fanau ai i latou.

verses.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
verses.sm: Ua ia vaai atu i ai, ona ia tu‘inanau atu ai lea ia te i latou; na ia aauina atu foi auauna ia te i latou i Kaletaia.

verses.en: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea o tagata o Papelonia ia te ia i le moega e faatasi ai, ona latou faaleaga lea ia te ia i a latou faitaaga, ona leaga ai lea o ia ia te i latou, ona liliu ese ai lea o lona loto ia te i latou.

verses.en: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
verses.sm: Na ia faaalia lona talitane, na ia faaalia foi lona le lavalava; ona liliu ese ai lea o loʻu loto ia te ia, e pei ona liliu ese o loʻu loto i lona uso.

verses.en: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
verses.sm: A ua ia faateleina lona talitane i lona manatu i ona po ina o teine muli o ia, na ia talitane ai i le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
verses.sm: Aua na ia tu‘inanau atu ia latou momoe ma ia, o latou tino e pei o le tino o le asini, ma le sua o latou tino e pei o le sua o le tino o le solofanua.

verses.en: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
verses.sm: Ua e toe manatua mea leaga na e faia ina o E teine muli, ina ua omia ou susu e tagata o Aikupito ona o ou susu ina o e teine muli.

verses.en: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
verses.sm: O le mea lea. Aolipa e, o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le Alii le ATUA, Faauta, ou te faaoso e tau ma oe e sa mananao ia te oe, o e ua liliu ese ai lou loto, ou te aumaia i latou mai itu uma, latou te tau ma oe;

verses.en: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
verses.sm: o tagata o Papelonia, atoa ma Kaletaia uma, o Pekota, ma Soa, ma Koa, o tagata uma o Asuria e faatasi ma i latou; o taulelea aulelei, o ta‘ita‘i, ma faipule i latou uma, o e ave ‘au ma e taʻua, o tietie i latou uma i solofanua.

verses.en: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
verses.sm: E o mai i latou ia te oe ma auupega, ma kariota, ma mea taavavale, ma ‘au o nuu; latou te vagaia oe ma le talipupuni, ma le talita, ma le puloutau; ou te tuuina foi le faamasinoga i o latou luma, latou te faamasino ia te oe e tusa ma a latou faamasinoga.

verses.en: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
verses.sm: Ou te faaoo atu lo'u fua ia te oe, latou te faasaua lava ia te oe; latou te fisiesea lou isu, ma ou taliga; e oti i le pelu e ua totoe ia te oe; latou te ave au tama tane ma au tama fafine, e faaumatia foi i le afi e ua totoe ia te oe.

verses.en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
verses.sm: Latou te toese foi ia te oe ou ofu, ma ave au teuga matagofie.

verses.en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
verses.sm: Ou te faaiuina lou leaga ma lou talitane mai le nuu o Aikupito; ona e le toe faasaga ae lea o ou mata ia te i latou, ma e le toe manatua lava Aikupito.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
verses.sm: Aua o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii le ATUA, Faauta, ou te tuuina atu oe i lima o e ua e ‘ino‘ino i ai, o lima o e ua liliu ese ai lou loto.

verses.en: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.sm: Latou te “ino“ino lava ia te oe, latou te ave foi au mea uma sa e tautiga ai, latou te tuua oe e le ufiufitia ma le le lavalava; e faaalia foi le leaga o lou talitane, o lou ulavale atoa ma au faitaaga.

verses.en: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.
verses.sm: Ou te faia ia mea ia te oe, aua ua e mulimuli atu i nuu ese e faitaaga ai, o i latou ia ua leaga ai oe i a latou tupua.

verses.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
verses.sm: Ua e savali i le ala o lou uso; o le mea lea ou te tuuina atu ai lana ipu i lou lima.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii le ATUA, E te inu i le ipu a lou uso, E loloto ma le tele, e fai oe ma mea e featani ai ma tauemuina ai; e tele lava mea o ¡ ai.

verses.en: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
verses.sm: E faatumuina oe i le onaga ma le faanoanoa, O le ipu o le fememeai ma le faatafunaga, o le ipu a lou uso o Samaria.

verses.en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.sm: E te inu ai ma mitia lava, e te taei foi i ona taega ipu, ma e saeia ou lava susu; aua o au ua ou fai atu ai, o loo faapea mai ai le Alii le ATUA.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.sm: O le mea lea o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le Alii le ATUA. Ua e faagalogalo mai ia te au, ma ua e lafoaiina aʻu i ou tua, O le mea lea ia taui ai ia te oe o lou ulavale, ma au faitaaga.

verses.en: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia te au, Le atalii e o le tagata, e te le faamasino ea ia Aola ma Aolipa, ma e faaali ia te i laua a laua mea e inosia?

verses.en: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
verses.sm: Aua ua la mulilulua, ua i ai foi le toto i o laua lima; ua la mulilulua i a la tupua; o a laua fanau foi na la fanau mai ai ia te au, ua la faaui ane i le afi, ia faaumatia ai mo i latou.

verses.en: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
verses.sm: Ua la faia foi lenei mea ia te au; ua la faaleagaina lo'u malumalu i lea lava aso, ma oʻu sapati ua la solia;

verses.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
verses.sm: ua la fasia a laua fanau mo tupua, ona o mai ai lea o i laua i loʻu malumalu i lea lava aso e soli ai; faauta foi, na faapea ona la faia i totonu o lo‘u fale.

verses.en: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
verses.sm: I le ma lea foi, ua oulua feauina tane ia o mai i le mea mamao, na auina atu ia te i latou le auauna, faauta foi, na latou o mai; na e taele ona o i latou, ma e valia ou mata, ma e teuteu i mea e faamatagofie a“.

verses.en: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
verses.sm: Na e nofo foi i luga o le moega lalelei, ua saunia le laulau i ona luma, na e faaeeina i ona luga aʻu mea manogi, ma aʻu suauu.

verses.en: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
verses.sm: Na ia te ia foi le leo o le vao tagata ua nonofo faatalanoa; na aumaia foi ia te ia e faatasi ma tagata lautele, o tagata Sepea mai le vao, sa i ai taulima i o latou lima, ma pale matagofie i o latou ulu.

verses.en: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
verses.sm: Ona ou fai atu ai lea ia te ia le ua loa ona fai pea o muliluaga, Latou te faitaaga lava ea ma ia, o ia foi ma i atou?

verses.en: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
verses.sm: A ua latou o ane lava ia te ia, e pei ona latou o ane i le fafine talitane, na faapea ona latou o ane ia Aola ma Aolipa, o fafine ulavavale.

verses.en: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.sm: O tagata amiotonu latou te faamasino ia te i laua, e pei ona faamasino o fafine mulilulua, e pei ona faamasino foi o fafine e faamaligi toto; aua o fafine mulilulua i laua, ua i ai foi le toto i o laua lima.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
verses.sm: Aua o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii le ATUA, Ou te aveina ae le motu o tagata ia te i laua, ou te tuuina atu foi i laua ia faasaunoaina, ma ia vetea a laua mea.

verses.en: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.sm: E fetogia i laua e le motu o tagata i maa, e taia i laua i a latou pelu; latou te fasiotia foi a laua tama tane ma a laua tama fafine, ma susunuina o laua fale i le afi.

verses.en: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.sm: Ona ou faagataina lea o le ulavale i le nuu, ina ia aʻoaʻo ai fafine uma ia le toe fai e pei o lo oulua ulavale.

verses.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.sm: Latou te taui atu lava lo oulua ulavale ia te oulua, e taui foi ia te oulua le agasala i a oulua tupua; ona oulua Poa ai lea o aʻu lava o le
